title: Bug: PDDF CPLDMUX initialization fails
author: lotus-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

pddf initialization on all platforms which use cpldmux will fail since pddfparse looks at the wrong path when setting the i2c_name.

### Steps to Reproduce

Any PDDF platform using CPLDMUX will hit this bug during initialization.

Currently no PDDF platforms in master use CPLDMUX.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

pddfparse will try to access the incorrectly path and print an error.
